notable_absence.finding: This entire page documents Management API endpoints (GET/PUT/POST against .../auditLog and .../auditLogEvents and .../auditLogExports) but never once states what API key scope, role, or permission is required to call them. Unlike server/'s RBAC docs, which name a specific privilege for admin actions, this page is silent on the actual access-control gate for these API calls - presumably a Capella API key with sufficient organization/project scope, per cloud/security/security.json's org:organization-project-role-model, but that link is not made explicit anywhere on this page.

cross_product_finding: Wording inconsistency worth flagging to the coordinator (not as a docs-issue file, just noted here): cloud/security/auditing.md says auditing requires an 'Enterprise Support Plan', while this page (audit-management.md) says it requires an 'Enterprise Service Plan'. These are presumably meant to be the same gating concept - I mapped both onto the single minted concept plan:enterprise-support-plan - but the source text itself is inconsistent about the plan's name, which is itself evidence that Capella's plan-based feature gating is a real, distinct axis from server/'s edition-based gating (no server/ page would describe an edition inconsistently like this within two pages of the same feature).
